Azer elemental bust: broad stocky dwarf-like bronze-metal face and shoulders, hair and full beard made of compact orange flame, one solid dark iron smith hammer behind one shoulder. Metallic living body, stern calm expression. No human skin, no demon horns. Broad sculpted brush shapes, strong recognizable silhouette at 32 pixels, moderate detail, restrained polished fantasy painting consistent with a collectible bestiary. Warm upper left lighting, dark outlined outer edges readable on ivory and charcoal. Subject occupies central 75 percent with at least 8 percent clear padding. TRUE TRANSPARENT background.
